description: Reusable operating procedures for a host agent that drives android-artifact-recovery. Each prompt names the command sequence, the evidence to collect, and the stop conditions. All prompts assume the operator owns or is authorized to inspect the artifact.
global_rules: Never claim a result you did not observe. Quote the command and its exit code.
Preserve the original artifact before any decode, patch or sign step.
Static findings are risks, not proof of runtime behaviour. Say which claims are untested.
Do not attempt authentication, licensing, DRM, purchase or integrity bypasses.
Ask for explicit confirmation before sign, rebuild or preserve (all three require --confirm).

prompts.title: First contact with an unknown artifact
prompts.use_when: A file with an Android-ish name arrives and its true format is unknown.
steps: If kind is apk: badging, zip-health, compat-scan
If kind is malformed-zip: stop and report the ZIP diagnosis; do not extract
Report the detected kind, package identity, SDK levels and finding severities

prompts.title: Assess whether an old APK can still run
prompts.use_when: A preserved build must be checked against current Android versions.
stop_conditions: targetSdk below 31 with intent-filtered components lacking android:exported (installation blocker)
prompts.reporting: List blockers separately from warnings, and state that no device run was performed.

prompts.title: 16 KB page-size readiness
prompts.use_when: Preparing for Android 15+ 16 KB devices or a store 16 KB requirement.
steps: If failures: rebuild from source with an NDK that links 16 KB-aligned libraries, then zipalign -P 16 -f 4 and re-sign
stop_conditions: any library fails ELF alignment or ZIP alignment
prompts.reporting: Report per-library alignment values; never state '16 KB ready' from a build log alone.

prompts.title: Authorized decode, patch and rebuild
prompts.use_when: You own the app or have written permission to modify it.
steps: Make the smallest change; keep a unified diff in work/change.patch
Record: original sha256, patch sha256, output sha256, signing identity
stop_conditions: the change touches signed or licensed code paths you are not authorized to modify

prompts.title: Explain why an update will not install
steps: Compare SHA-256 digests, not common names
Explain that Android requires the same signing key (or an authorized rotation) for an in-place update
prompts.reporting: Never suggest disabling verification; the correct options are uninstall/reinstall or signing with the original key.

prompts.title: Batch inventory of an archive of builds
prompts.use_when: A folder of APKs/AABs needs a fleet-level summary.
steps: triage each status=error row individually with identify and zip-health
Summarize by targetSdk bucket and ABI coverage
stop_conditions: more than the configured max_artifacts_per_batch artifacts
prompts.reporting: Quote the capped count when the limit applies.

prompts.title: Decide whether the task is actually complete
prompts.use_when: Before telling a user that recovery or repair succeeded.
steps: Confirm each requested deliverable exists on disk (artifacts[] in the report)
Confirm verify returned exit code 0 for any produced APK
Confirm the report lists untested claims under limitations
State explicitly which runtime checks were NOT performed
stop_conditions: any produced APK was not verified
the request implied a device test that was never run
